title: A cleaner Python API for my next project

messages.content: Help me design a Python API with a SQLite database for my project.
Start with three layers: request handling, domain logic, and database access. Keep SQL statements parameterized.
How should I test the database migration?
Use a temporary database. Check both the old schema upgrade and a new installation.

title: Making sense of calculus, one question at a time

messages.content: I have a calculus exam. Explain the derivative with a practical example.
A derivative measures how quickly a quantity changes. The slope of a distance-time curve gives instantaneous speed.
Give me an assignment practice question.
For f(x) = x² + 3x, find f′(x) and the slope at x = 2.

title: كيف أنظم المصادر والمراجع في البحث؟

messages.content: أريد تنظيم مصادر بحث عربي وتوثيق الاقتباسات من المكتبة الشاملة.
أنشئ بطاقة لكل مرجع تسجل فيها اسم الكتاب والمؤلف والجزء والصفحة. ميّز بين النص المنقول والتلخيص، وراجع كل اقتباس في مصدره.

title: An email that gets the point across

messages.content: Rewrite my email asking for feedback on an essay draft.

Subject: Feedback on my essay draft

Dear Professor,
Could you review the attached draft and suggest improvements to the argument and organization?
Thank you.

title: An Obsidian library that feels like a second brain

messages.content: For my project, design a roadmap for organizing AI conversations in Obsidian.
Start with reliable imports, add clear categories, then connect related notes through topic hubs. Provide a visual Canvas for exploration.
Help me make a weekend travel schedule with time for reading.
Leave the morning open for travel. Reserve an hour after lunch for reading, and keep the evening flexible.
Review this TypeScript code. The API returns an error when a field is missing.
Validate the input at the boundary, then return a clear error before calling the database.
أحتاج خطة دراسة لمادة الرياضيات قبل الامتحان في الجامعة.
خصص كل يوم لموضوع واحد. راجع التعريفات ثم حل مسائل متنوعة، وسجل الأخطاء لتراجعها في اليوم التالي.
